The Lead
Humiliation, and Resurrection

by Dennis Speed (EIRNS) — Sep. 10, 2026

Today, 25 years after “9/11,” the United States, and its still-extant—but not intact—Presidential system, must be viewed from above its vicissitudes, including the nearly successful attempt to destroy it on September 11, 2001. That attempt was carried out by forces operating from inside and outside the nation. The American Presidential system must also be viewed from above the personalities that have occupied the White House in the last generation, in order to understand what our pathway out of perpetual war, and thermonuclear war, might now be. So, from the mountaintop, not of 25 years, or the nation’s 250 years, but the 2620 years that have elapsed from the time of the Constitution of Solon of Athens in 594 B.C. until now, let us consider one essential, but now-omitted-from-memory aspect of what happened that day.

Economist and statesman Lyndon LaRouche, who was on the Jack Stockwell radio broadcast as the World Trade Center attack unfolded that day, pointed out, one year later, on January 24, 2002, that “there was an escalation, a security alert, which went up automatically on the basis of these attacks, especially the attack on the Pentagon. When somebody attacks the Pentagon in that fashion, which threatens to wipe out the military command in Washington, that is the alarm signal which automatically guarantees that the United States goes on a full-scale thermonuclear alert. That’s the only thing that happens.

“Now, that did happen. It was referred to by President Bush on several occasions later, including his address in Crawford, Texas, where Putin was standing beside him: stating that while he was on the phone to a thermonuclear second strike base, Offutt, in Nebraska, that he had a conversation with President Putin of Russia, and that President Putin in effect said to him, ‘I know you’re in trouble. I know the United States has put up its thermonuclear alert service system. I’m taking down ours’—that is, the Russians’, which was doing a practice alert—‘in order to help you get out of this mess.’

“So the President, of course, in that circumstance, under these kinds of conditions, was the only person who had the authority to shut down, or order the shut down, of the alert. And he was alive and able to do it. That prevented the crisis from going totally out of control.”

To be clear: on September 11, 2001, Donald Rumsfeld, then Secretary of Defense, ordered a DEFCON 3 level mobilization of the United States’ thermonuclear forces, with a standby to go to DEFCON 2–the exact level of nuclear alert of the Cuban Missile Crisis. Is that remembered by the two-thirds of Americans who were witnesses to those events? Was it ever known to them? Do the 100 million Americans either not born or too young to have understood 9/11 even know about that nuclear alert?

President Vladimir Putin, who was there then, and is now, remembers it. Is it even imaginable to today’s America that Vladimir Putin would have, two months after September 11, 2001, appeared together with President G. W. Bush, in person, at a high school in Crawford, Texas? On that occasion, Bush said, “It’s my honor also to introduce President Putin to Crawford. I bet a lot of folks here, particularly the older folks, never dreamt that an American President would be bringing the Russian President to Crawford, Texas. (Laughter.) A lot of people never really dreamt that an American President and a Russian President could have established the friendship that we have.

“We were enemies for a long period of time. When I was in high school, Russia was an enemy. Now the high school students can know Russia as a friend; that we’re working together to break the old ties, to establish a new spirit of cooperation and trust so that we can work together to make the world more peaceful.” Now, think: if such an incident, “a new 9/11,” occurred today, would the necessary trust exist between the United States and Russia, or the United States and China such that a de-escalation from the brink of world destruction could even be averted? We cannot doubt the apparent answer at this time. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has recently expressed it thus: “the relations with [the West] that existed before February, 2022 will never again exist.”

The importance of the “Appeal to Pope Leo XIV To Organize a Global Leaders Summit To Address the Questions of Peace and Nuclear Disarmament” now being circulated by the International Peace Coalition and many other organizations is that it must be a means of going outside of the failures of the American Presidential system at this moment, to attempt to establish a dialogue of civilizations, and a culture not only of survival, but of progress. In an address made yesterday to the First West Africa Youth Day gathering, the Pope observed, “One of the challenges you face is that of walking together to help bring about positive change in your societies.” Walking together means ensuring that no one is marginalized, isolated, excluded or rejected.  Be builders of bridges between peoples, cultures and religions. Today’s performance of Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony in Manhattan by the Schiller Institute NYC Chorus, plus orchestra and soloists seeks to do just that. “Beethoven’s Ninth: A Pathway Out of War” invokes the “mountaintop” standpoint from which all future world diplomacy that would be successful must proceed. The dignity of humanity, whatever the delusions of the AI mythologists may be, is the currency of human interaction that must rule the world, or there will be no more world.

This is, of course, the function of the Executive Intelligence Review and its Daily Alert. It supplies the kind of briefing that President John Quincy Adams, a consummate diplomat, Greek and Latin scholar, and opponent of slavery and colonialism, would have appreciated. Adams not only knew who Solon of Athens was; he knew why the United States was the continuation of Solon’s Athenian tradition—not the tradition of Sparta, and of Lycurgus, the tradition that dominates the United States today.

“Intelligence, Not Information” has long been our intention, standard, and product. “Current history, not current events” is another way to put it. Competent strategic thinking demands that the current of history of 2620 years of statecraft be the vantage point from which free citizens around the world must make judgments as to what is to be done by us, each day, in a world of 8 billion teetering on the verge of a worldwide Renaissance or thermonuclear extinction. Making the decision to end perpetual war and perpetual surveillance, on this 25th anniversary, in the 250th year of America’s Independence from colonialism, when viewed from the mountaintop of Solon’s constitutional revolution, is a human strategy that must supersede the doomed pragmatism of geopolitics.

A buddy reached out to ask how we use remote team members to do marketing for West Coast Deck (he runs a landscaping biz and is hoping to replicate some of what we do)

I made a list of stuff you can do from anywhere in the world (e.g hire a marketing lead based in Peru) that has helped us do over 10 figs of organic revenue - pasting below (also if you have stuff to add to this, please comment here and I'll make a google doc with all the suggestions that we can share)

West Coast Deck Remote Marketing Playbook

<Google Business Profile>
Publish 2–4 GBP posts/week; upload new project photos; add project/service descriptions; answer Q&A; monitor new reviews; draft responses to every review; keep services/service areas current

<Reviews>
Send review requests after completed projects; follow up with customers who haven't reviewed; maintain review-request tracker; collect reviews into a database; identify great reviews for social posts; flag unhappy customers immediately

<Instagram / Facebook>
Schedule project photos, Reels and Stories; turn jobsite content into before/after posts; write captions; tag locations/products; respond to basic comments and DMs; maintain posting calendar

<Short-form video>
Take raw videos from the field team and organize them; identify usable clips; add captions/titles using templates; create simple Reels/TikToks/Shorts; schedule publishing across platforms (you prob have a separate editor do this)

<Project content>
Create a marketing folder for every completed project; organize before/during/after photos; record project type, city, products, square footage, challenges and outcome; turn each project into multiple pieces of content

<Website / SEO>
Draft project case studies; create city/service landing-page content; update project galleries; add completed projects; optimize image filenames/alt text; identify old pages needing updates; maintain internal-linking checklist

<Local SEO>
Track GBP rankings; maintain consistent business listings/citations; find relevant local directories; submit/update profiles; research local backlinks; identify HOA/property-management/architect/contractor directories

<Email marketing>
Maintain customer/prospect lists; clean and segment contacts; build monthly newsletter; create past-customer campaigns; send seasonal deck-maintenance/refinishing campaigns; track opens/clicks/leads

<Past-customer marketing>
Build database of previous customers; send periodic check-ins; ask for referrals; promote refinishing/maintenance; identify customers whose decks are approaching maintenance intervals

<Referral program>
Track referral partners; send follow-ups; maintain architect/designer/GC/property-manager lists; send periodic project updates; remind partners what types of leads WCD wants

<HOA / Property Management outreach>
Build targeted lists of HOAs and property managers; research contacts; maintain CRM records; prepare personalized outreach; follow up systematically; distribute balcony/waterproofing educational material

<Architect / Designer outreach>
Research local architects, landscape architects and designers; add contacts to CRM; follow them socially; engage appropriately; send portfolio/project introductions; track relationships

<Builder / GC relationships>
Build lists of custom-home builders and remodelers; research decision makers; maintain outreach cadence; send relevant project examples; track responses and opportunities

<Direct Mail>
Build homeowner mailing lists around current/completed jobs; coordinate postcards; maintain Every Door Direct Mail campaigns; track neighborhoods mailed; coordinate follow-up campaigns

<Jobsite marketing>
Maintain list of active projects; ensure signs/banners are deployed; identify surrounding neighborhoods for door hangers/mailers; coordinate marketing materials with field team

<Facebook Groups / Nextdoor>
Identify relevant community groups; monitor deck/patio/contractor recommendation posts; flag opportunities; post approved educational/project content where permitted

<Facebook Marketplace>
Maintain listings for decks, patio covers, railings, waterproofing, refinishing, etc.; rotate photos and copy; refresh listings; route inquiries into your lead process

<PR + Publications>
Maintain media list; identify local publications and home/design outlets; pitch interesting projects; submit projects for features/awards; track editorial calendars

<Houzz / Yelp / Angi etc.>
Keep portfolios current; upload projects; respond to reviews/messages; maintain profile information; track which platforms actually generate leads

<Competitive research>
Monitor competitors' GBP activity, reviews, websites, ads and social content; maintain competitor spreadsheet; identify offers/content/topics that appear to be working

<Content research>
Build lists of homeowner questions from Google, Reddit, YouTube, sales calls and customer questions; turn them into content ideas for you to answer on camera

<CRM hygiene>
Make sure marketing source is recorded; clean duplicate contacts; categorize leads; update referral sources; maintain lost-lead reasons; create lists for remarketing

<Marketing reporting>
Produce a simple weekly dashboard: leads by source, reviews received, GBP activity, content published, website leads, social performance, outreach completed and appointments generated

👽⚡ KAV is the Alien of Solana - and KAV loves turning “I don’t know how” into “Which tool can help me?”

🤖 TODAY’S KAV AI SIGNAL: FIND THE RIGHT TOOL

You don’t need to master every skill yourself.

Today, AI can help you design, research, code, create presentations, generate voices, build 3D models, enhance photos and much more.

The better question is no longer:

❌ “Do I know how to do this?”

Ask:

✅ “What tool can help me do this—and how do I verify the result?”

Here are some useful tools worth knowing 👇

🎨 1️⃣ Need images, logos, vectors or design assets? - Recraft

Describe your idea and generate images, illustrations, editable vectors and other creative assets.
🔗 https://t.co/NFk1eF7qB0

🖼️ 2️⃣ Need to open or edit a PSD without Photoshop? - Photopea

A browser-based editor with full PSD support, layers, masks and even AI-powered features such as background removal and generative editing.
🔗 https://t.co/P6ww1aw1ZX

🧊 3️⃣ Need a 3D model but don’t know 3D modeling? - Meshy

Give it a text description or reference image and AI can generate a textured 3D model for further editing or export.
🔗 https://t.co/QVkzf5VLJQ

✨ 4️⃣ Have a blurry or low-resolution image? - Upscayl

A free, open-source AI upscaler for Windows, macOS and Linux. Its desktop version can process images locally on your computer.
🔗 https://t.co/QGEk6doeWB

🔎 5️⃣ Need faster research? - Perplexity

Ask a question and it searches the web, combines information and provides source-backed answers. Still open the sources yourself for important claims.
🔗 https://t.co/S6r99EyBMD

📊 6️⃣ Need a presentation but design isn’t your strength? - Gamma

Give it your topic, notes or existing content and AI can help create presentations, documents and webpages.
🔗 https://t.co/OYu4ypBDEI

💻 7️⃣ Want help coding or building software? - Cursor

An AI-powered code editor that can understand a codebase, explain code, generate changes and help find or fix bugs.
🔗 https://t.co/mGnhXLKqcO

🎙️ 8️⃣ Need realistic AI narration or voiceovers? - ElevenLabs

Turn written text into natural-sounding speech for videos, narration and other audio projects.
🔗 https://t.co/PV4JIgxtm3

💡 Example:
Imagine you want to launch a product but you aren’t a designer, 3D artist, developer or presenter.

You could use Recraft → Meshy → Cursor → Gamma → ElevenLabs to move from visual concept → 3D asset → prototype → presentation → narration.

🧠 KAV Advice:
AI doesn't mean “press one button and trust everything.”

Describe clearly → Generate → Check the result → Verify facts → Improve → Create.

🔐 And never upload confidential documents, passwords, wallet seed phrases or sensitive client information to an AI service without understanding its privacy policy.

👽 KAV Wisdom:
The future won’t only reward people who know everything.

It will reward people who know how to learn, choose the right tools, and think critically.

➕ KAVIANS - what useful AI tool should we add to the next list?

Professional Image-Generation Prompt
Prompt:
Create a photorealistic cinematic black-and-white editorial photograph of a stylish young adult man sitting calmly on a simple metal stool in an open rugged countryside landscape, with a large powerful black horse standing directly behind him. The horse’s head rests naturally close to the man’s head and shoulder, creating a striking sense of companionship and scale.
The man has messy, textured medium-length dark hair, wearing dark rectangular sunglasses, a loose black button-up shirt layered beneath a relaxed oversized black jacket, extremely wide-leg black trousers, and worn black leather boots. He sits in a relaxed, slightly introspective pose with his head tilted downward, one hand resting naturally between his knees while holding the horse’s reins.
The horse should look majestic and realistic, with detailed dark coat texture, visible musculature, natural mane, expressive eyes, upright ears, and authentic leather bridle and reins.
Set the scene in a wild mountainous countryside, with dry grass, rocks, shrubs, an earthy dirt path, and distant softly blurred hills. Use dramatic natural daylight, strong monochrome tonal separation, deep blacks, bright highlights, subtle film grain, and atmospheric depth.
Composition: vertical full-body portrait, low-to-medium camera angle, man positioned in the lower center foreground and horse towering behind him, balanced visual hierarchy, generous negative space around the subjects.
Photography style: luxury fashion editorial + cinematic western aesthetic, timeless analog photography, high contrast, realistic skin and fabric textures, natural shadows, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, subtle background bokeh, 35mm/50mm lens, professional fashion photography, ultra-detailed, realistic proportions, authentic anatomy, HDR-quality tonal range, sophisticated and moody atmosphere.
Color grading: pure black and white, rich charcoal blacks, soft silver highlights, no color tint.
Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical.
Quality: ultra-photorealistic, high resolution, cinematic, editorial magazine quality.

We hope to launch the Verification Age for video models: 50 scientists, 6 months, 100 rule-based verifiers, 300 new tasks, and a worked RL recipe. 

Coding models are advancing crazily thanks to the synthetic RL envs paradigms. Verification via codes or Lean gives models super-human math/coding intelligence like that in Astra and Fable. 

However, video models are still in the GPT-3 stage, where we just dump million hours video data into the model training and hope for magic.

In this work, 
1) we built 100 rule-based verifiers each paired with a synthetic data generators which give 10k+ diverse samples within the task domain 
2) we made additional 300 tasks generators, including classic games i.e. Snake, Gold Miner, Mario, to further scale training data distribution with million samples rendered ready available on HuggingFace 
3)  ~60 experiments to find a worked RL recipe for video model post-training 
4) comparison studies between image models, unified models, video models - which is the best model for visual thinking? 
5) failure modes of how VLM-as-Judge will not satisfy video models RL in long term
6) interpretability studies show all image models, unified models, video models emerged "Schrödinger Effect", CoS reasoning through diffusion steps
7) many more insights 

A detailed thread [1/n]

Uno shows a simple way to speed up existing LLMs without changing their output distribution: keep the original model in charge, and use diffusion only to draft multiple tokens in parallel.

Keep the autoregressive model for quality and add diffusion for parallel drafting

On Qwen3-8B, Uno delivered 2.5X higher per-request throughput and 1.6X higher system throughput at the largest tested batch size.

Normal autoregressive LLMs generate 1 token at a time, making long responses, agents, and RL rollouts slow.

Uno adds lightweight diffusion adapters that propose several future tokens at once, while the original model verifies them.

That avoids a separate draft model and preserves the base model’s sampling behavior.

It also sped up end-to-end RL training by up to 40% in the reported runs.
